q: What is the document number of the IT Policy Book?
expected: P-IT-E&IT-01.

q: Who approves exceptions to Part A of the IT policy?
expected: The Sr. GM — ERP & IT approves exceptions to Part A; exceptions affecting security architecture, the Data Centre or DR are approved by the Executive Director on the Sr. GM's recommendation.

q: Within how many working days must access rights be removed when an employee changes role?
expected: Rights that no longer match the new role are removed within 3 working days of the change.

q: What is the minimum password length for privileged accounts?
expected: 12 or more characters (10 for normal accounts), mixing letters, numbers and symbols.

q: If someone does not log in for a couple of months, what happens to their account?
expected: Accounts unused for 60 days without an approved reason are disabled and reported to the department head.

q: How long are service desk ticket records retained?
expected: At least 2 years, for trend analysis and audit.

q: What are the response and resolution targets for a P1 ticket?
expected: Response within 15 minutes (30 minutes after-hours); resolution within 4 hours to restore service, with hourly updates.

q: What are the default backup retention periods?
expected: Daily sets 30 days; weekly sets 3 months; monthly archives 12 months; year-end financial/ERP archives as Finance requires.

q: How often are DR drills conducted and on which form are they recorded?
expected: At least quarterly (fuller exercise annually), recorded on Form IT-08.

q: Who decides DR invocation?
expected: The Sr. GM — ERP & IT with the ED's approval; the senior-most available IT staff may begin failover immediately if the primary site is evidently destroyed or unsafe.

q: Within how many days must critical security patches be deployed on servers?
expected: Within 15 days (routine updates in the monthly window).

q: How often is the firewall rule base reviewed?
expected: Half-yearly; temporary rules carry expiry dates.

q: Which form is the gate pass for moving IT equipment?
expected: Form IT-05 — Gate Pass: IT Equipment Movement.

q: Within how many hours must theft or loss of IT equipment be reported?
expected: Within 24 hours to the department head, the IT Section and, for portable devices, Security.

q: How many quotations are required for an IT purchase?
expected: At least three quotations where the market allows; fewer only with recorded justification.

q: Within how many days must an emergency IT purchase be regularized?
expected: Within 7 days, with full documentation.

q: What are the four classes of IT change?
expected: Standard, Normal, Major and Emergency.

q: Which form is used to release CCTV footage and who approves it?
expected: Form IT-10, approved by HR & Admin or the Sr. GM — ERP & IT (and the ED for sensitive cases).

q: What does an employee acknowledge by signing Form IT-11?
expected: That they have received, read and understood Part A (Chapters 3–9) of the IT Policy Book and agree to comply with it.

q: What is the recovery time objective for the ERP and production databases?
expected: RTO 8 hours; RPO 4 hours with transaction protection or 24 hours with full-backup fallback.

q: Which RMG factories are covered locations of the IT Section?
expected: TAL, KTL, BGL and RHL.

q: Which Wi-Fi platform does the Group use?
expected: Centralized controller-based Wi-Fi on the UniFi platform with unified SSIDs and an isolated guest SSID.

q: How often must the Data Centre and power room be inspected?
expected: At least twice daily on working days.

q: Who is the L3 escalation contact and when is L3 engaged?
expected: The Sr. General Manager — ERP & IT (Md. Johirul Islam): P1 beyond 1 hour, all confirmed security incidents, Major changes, vendor/ISP contract escalation and policy exceptions.

q: What are the three data classification levels?
expected: Confidential, Internal and Public.

q: Within how many working days must infrastructure documentation be updated after a change?
expected: Within 5 working days.

q: What does SOP-20 cover?
expected: Password Reset & Account Unlock — verifying the requester's identity before resetting.

q: What laptop specification does a manager get?
expected: Manager and above get a Core i7 (or equivalent) laptop; below Manager a Core i5 (or equivalent).

q: Which form is used to request a laptop?
expected: A department requisition on Form IT-03 with approval, processed via SOP-27.

q: Who is responsible for SOP-02 New Joiner Setup?
expected: Executive — IT (device & orientation) and AM — IT Email & Server (accounts & mailbox).

q: How many on-premises Exchange mailboxes and Microsoft 365 licences does the Group have?
expected: About 1,270 on-premises Exchange mailboxes and 410 Microsoft 365 licences, including 300 Business Basic and 60 Business Standard.

q: How many laptops and desktops are in the endpoint fleet?
expected: 857 laptops and 334 desktops (as at 31/08/2026).

q: What is the minimum CCTV footage retention?
expected: A minimum of 30 days of recorded footage for every camera, verified weekly.

q: How does someone get VPN access approved?
expected: The request is sent by email to the DM — ERP & IT and access is granted only after the HOD of the requesting user's department replies with approval on the same mail thread.

q: What is the filename convention for network device configuration backups and how many versions are kept?
expected: device-name_YYYYMMDD, keeping at least the last 12 versions per device.

q: Within how many working days must a security incident be documented on Form IT-09?
expected: Within 3 working days.

q: Which purchased items are always received, quality-checked and GRN'd at Head Office?
expected: Laptops and firewall/networking devices; they are then dispatched to the site per SOP-06.

q: Where is the IT Inventory Management system (AMS) hosted?
expected: it.bitopibd.com/inventory.html

q: How does the Group dispose of retired IT equipment?
expected: IT hands the approved list to HR, which engages third parties and sells the items by auction or competitive bidding; storage is sanitized first.

q: At what disk free space level does the daily server check raise a flag?
expected: Below 20% free space.

q: How many Kaspersky endpoint security licences does the Group hold?
What must happen before an ERP change is deployed to production?
expected: The requesting department must send written UAT confirmation (mail from the Departmental Admin with the HOD's approval, or the signed UAT section of the change form); a verbal okay does not count.

q: Within how many days must SOPs be updated after a platform change?
expected: Within 30 days of the change going live.

q: What is the overtime rate for cutting staff?
expected: The HRMS overtime slab: Slab-1 (OT) rate 2, duration 2, and Slab-2 (EOT) rate 2, duration 5.
